items.title_cn: 重症急性胰腺炎患者早期肠内营养管理：启动、推进与耐受性指导调整策略的范围综述
items.title_en: Early Enteral Nutrition Management in Patients with Severe Acute Pancreatitis: A Scoping Review of Initiation, Advancement, and Tolerance-Guided Adjustment Strategies
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题聚焦重症急性胰腺炎的早期肠内营养管理，涵盖启动、推进及基于耐受性的调整策略，属于重症胰腺炎阶梯治疗中的关键支持治疗环节，与研究方向核心关注的重症胰腺炎诊治高度相关。由于未提供摘要，无法总结具体研究发现。

items.title_cn: CRP/白蛋白比值与太原中央医院急性胰腺炎患者的一些实验室指标
items.title_en: TỶ SỐ CRP/ALBUMIN VÀ MỘT SỐ CHỈ SỐ CẬN LÂM SÀNG Ở BỆNH NHÂN VIÊM TỤY CẤP TẠI BỆNH VIỆN TRUNG ƯƠNG THÁI NGUYÊN
items.abstract_cn:
急性胰腺炎是一种常见的胃肠道急症，临床表现多样，其重症形式可能危及生命。CRP/白蛋白比值是一种反映全身炎症和营养状况的标志物，可用于预测急性胰腺炎的严重程度。
目的：通过分析泰国阮国家医院急性胰腺炎的受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线下面积（AUC），评估C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值对2012年修订版亚特兰大分类所定义的重症急性胰腺炎的预测价值。
对象与方法：对泰国阮国家医院166例急性胰腺炎患者进行横断面研究。
结果：根据修订版亚特兰大分类，40例患者（24.1%）被归类为重症AP，91例患者（54.8%）为轻症AP，35例患者（21.1%）为中度AP。血浆CRP、白蛋白水平及CRP/白蛋白比值对急性胰腺炎的严重程度均显示出良好的预测价值，相应的AUC值分别为0.88、0.90和0.95（95% CI：0.82–0.93；0.85–0.95；0.92–0.98），对应的截断值分别为200.5 mg/L、37.3 g/L和5.11，灵敏度和特异度分别为84.1%和81.9%；82.5%和89.9%；88.1%和87.9%。
结论：CRP、白蛋白水平及CRP/白蛋白比值是预测急性胰腺炎严重程度的有用指标。
items.abstract_en:
Acute pancreatitis is a common gastrointestinal emergency with diverse clinical manifestations and its severe forms may be life-threatening. The CRP/albumin ratio, a marker reflecting systemic inflammation and nutritional status, may be used to predict the severity of acute pancreatitis. 
Objective: To evaluate the predictive value of the C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio for severe acute pancreatitis, as defined by the 2012 Revised Atlanta Classification, by analyzing the area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC) of acute pancreatitis at Thai Nguyen National Hospital. 
Subjects and methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted on 166 patients with acute pancreatitis at Thai Nguyen National Hospital. 
Results: According to the revised Atlanta classification, 40 patients (24.1%) were classified as having severe AP, while 91 patients (54.8%) had mild AP and 35 patients (21.1%) had morderate AP. Plasma CRP, albumin level and the CRP/albumin ratio showed good predictive value for the severity of acute pancreatitis, with corresponding AUC values of 0.88, 0.90, and 0.95 (95% CI: 0.82–0.93; 0.85–0.95; and 0.92–0.98, respectively) at the corresponding cut-off points of 200.5 mg/L, 37.3 g/L, and 5.11, the sensitivity and specificity were 84.1% and 81.9%; 82.5% and 89.9%; 88.1% and 87.9%, respectively. 
Conclusion: CRP, albumin level and the CRP/albumin ratio are useful indicators for predicting the severity of acute pancreatitis.
items.journal: Tạp chí Y học Cộng đồng
items.summary_cn: 该研究在166例急性胰腺炎患者中评估了CRP/白蛋白比值对重症急性胰腺炎的预测价值，其AUC达0.95（95%CI 0.92–0.98），优于单独CRP（AUC 0.88）和白蛋白（AUC 0.90），在cut-off值5.11时敏感度和特异度分别为88.1%和87.9%。结论认为CRP、白蛋白水平及CRP/白蛋白比值均是预测急性胰腺炎严重程度的有用指标。

items.title_cn: 微创技术治疗胆总管结石相关梗阻性黄疸的临床疗效
items.title_en: CLINICAL EFFICACY OF MINIMALLY INVASIVE TECHNOLOGIES IN THE TREATMENT OF OBSTRUCTIVE JAUNDICE ASSOCIATED WITH CHOLEDOCHOLITHIASIS
items.abstract_cn: 背景。与胆总管结石相关的机械性黄疸以胆道梗阻、胆汁淤积、肝功能受损以及急性胆管炎和胆源性胰腺炎风险增加为特征。目的。评估微创诊断和治疗技术在胆总管结石所致机械性黄疸患者中的临床有效性，并论证最佳治疗策略。材料与方法。分析了2023年至2026年间在安集延国立医学院附属医院第三外科接受治疗的47例患者的临床数据。对照组包括25例患者，主组包括22例患者。使用了临床、实验室和仪器检查方法，包括超声检查、MSCT胆管造影和ERCP。结果。45-59岁患者分别占对照组的44.0%和主组的45.5%。女性分别占64.0%和63.6%。急性胆管炎发生率分别为36.0%和22.7%，胆源性胰腺炎发生率分别为24.0%和18.2%。无并发症病程分别为8.0%和27.3%。平均总胆红素分别为168.4±12.6和149.2±11.8 μmol/L。结论。超声检查、MSCT胆管造影和ERCP的联合应用能够评估结石定位和胆道梗阻情况。优化的微创策略与临床指标改善和并发症发生率降低相关。
items.abstract_en: Background. Mechanic al jaundice associated with choledocholithiasis is characterized by biliary obstruction, cholestasis, impaired liver function and an increased risk of acute cholangitis and biliary pancreatitis. Objective. To evaluate the clinical effectiveness of minimally invasive diagnostic and therapeutic technologies in patients with mechanical jaundice caused by choledocholithiasis and to substantiate an optimal treatment strategy. Materials and Methods. Clinical data from 47 patients treated at the 3rd Surgical Depar tment of the Clinic of Andijan State Medical Institute between 2023 and 2026 were analyzed. The comparison group included 25 patients and the main group 22 patients. Clinical, laboratory and instrumental methods, including ultrasonography, MSCT cholangiogr aphy and ERCP, were used. Results. Patients aged 45–59 years accounted for 44.0% of the comparison group and 45.5% of the main group. Women represented 64.0% and 63.6%, respectively. Acute cholangitis occurred in 36.0% and 22.7%, while biliary pancreatitis occurred in 24.0% and 18.2%. An uncomplicated course was observed in 8.0% and 27.3%, respectively. Mean total bilirubin was 168.4±12.6 and 149.2±11.8 μmol/L. Conclusion. The combined use of ultrasonography, MSCT cholangiography and ERCP enables assessment of stone localization and biliary obstruction. An optimized minimally invasive strategy was associated with improved clinical parameters and a lower frequency of complications.
items.summary_cn: 该研究分析了47例胆总管结石所致梗阻性黄疸患者，比较了微创诊疗技术（超声、MSCT胆道成像和ERCP）的应用效果，发现优化微创策略与临床指标改善及并发症减少相关。急性胆管炎和胆源性胰腺炎在两组中的发生率分别为36.0%/22.7%和24.0%/18.2%。

items.title_cn: 重症急性胰腺炎治疗期间发生的节段性动脉中层溶解
items.title_en: Segmental arterial mediolysis developing during treatment for severe acute pancreatitis.
items.abstract_cn: 我们描述了一例在重症急性胰腺炎治疗期间发生的节段性动脉中膜溶解症。患者为41岁男性，因重症酒精性胰腺炎住院。急性胰腺炎的临床病程良好。入院第10天，患者发生失血性休克。增强计算机断层扫描显示，在胰腺炎症部位远处新发动脉瘤，从而诊断为节段性动脉中膜溶解症。疑似破裂的动脉瘤通过导管介入成功栓塞，随后的临床病程良好。未破裂的动脉瘤在保守治疗下自行消退。发病后第142天，患者出现头痛和呕吐，影像学检查发现脑室内血肿，怀疑与节段性动脉中膜溶解症相关。据我们所知，这是首篇描述节段性动脉中膜溶解症与急性胰腺炎之间关系的报告。本病例强调了在胰腺炎患者中考虑将节段性动脉中膜溶解症作为腹腔内出血潜在病因的重要性。值得注意的是，动脉瘤形成和破裂发生在非常短的时间内；第3天未检测到动脉瘤，而第10天即发生破裂。这表明节段性动脉中膜溶解症中的动脉瘤形成可能在7天内发生。我们的观察为节段性动脉中膜溶解症中动脉瘤的快速进展提供了有价值的临床见解，并强调了在类似临床情况下早期识别和及时管理的重要性。
items.abstract_en: We describe a case of segmental arterial mediolysis that developed during treatment for severe acute pancreatitis. The patient is a 41-year-old male who was hospitalized for severe alcoholic pancreatitis. The clinical course of acute pancreatitis was favorable. On the 10th hospital day, the patient experienced hemorrhagic shock. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography revealed newly developed aneurysms distant from the site of pancreatic inflammation, leading to a diagnosis of segmental arterial mediolysis. The aneurysm suspected of rupture was successfully embolized by catheter intervention, and the subsequent clinical course was favorable.The unruptured aneurysm resolved spontaneously under conservative management. On day 142 after onset, the patient developed headache and vomiting, and imaging revealed an intraventricular hematoma, which was suspected to be associated with segmental arterial mediolysis. To our knowledge, this is the first report describing the relationship between segmental arterial mediolysis and acute pancreatitis. This case underscores the importance of considering segmental arterial mediolysis as a potential cause of intra-abdominal hemorrhage in patients with pancreatitis. Notably, aneurysm formation and rupture occurred within a very short period; no aneurysm was detected on day 3, whereas rupture occurred on day 10. This suggests that aneurysm development in segmental arterial mediolysis may occur within 7 days. Our observation provides valuable clinical insight into the rapid progression of aneurysms in segmental arterial mediolysis and highlights the need for early recognition and prompt management in similar clinical settings.
items.summary_cn: 本文首次报道了一例重症急性胰腺炎治疗期间发生节段性动脉中膜溶解（SAM）的病例，患者在入院第10天发生失血性休克，CT显示远离胰腺炎症部位的新发动脉瘤，提示SAM是胰腺炎患者腹腔内出血的潜在原因；且动脉瘤形成与破裂发生在极短时间内（第3天未检出，第10天即破裂），提示SAM中动脉瘤可能在7天内快速进展。

items.title_cn: 早期血液净化对重症急性胰腺炎血清炎症介质疗效的系统评价与Meta分析
items.title_en: Efficacy of early blood purification on serum inflammatory mediators in severe acute pancreatitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract_cn: 重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）是急性胰腺炎（AP）最危重的形式，以失调的全身炎症反应为特征，导致早期器官衰竭和死亡。当前的管理仍以支持治疗为主。早期血液净化（EBP）已被提出作为减少循环炎症介质的辅助策略，但既往的综合分析受到试验规模小、模式异质性强和报告不一致的限制。本研究旨在评估早期EBP在成人SAP中的疗效和安全性，并按治疗模式和启动时机对结局进行分层分析。对六个数据库（PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Ovid、Embase和Cochrane Library）进行了全面检索，检索截至2026年6月发表的研究。纳入的研究对象为成人SAP患者，比较早期EBP（连续性静脉-静脉血液滤过[CVVH]、高容量血液滤过[HVHF]、联合连续性血液净化、血液灌流、血浆置换或血液吸附）与标准内科治疗。汇总效应以标准化均数差（SMD）、均数差（MD）或风险比（RR）表示，采用随机效应模型，预先按治疗模式分层，并在可行时按启动时机分层。证据确定性采用GRADE框架评估。共纳入21项研究，包含1，959名成人患者。早期EBP与IL-6（SMD = − 1.55；95% CI：−2.05至− 1.05；12项研究，n = 1,045）和CRP（SMD = − 1.14；95% CI：−1.93至− 0.34；11项研究，n = 840）的总体显著降低相关，两种标志物的效应量在不同模式间差异显著。APACHE II评分也显著改善（MD = − 3.40；95% CI：−4.64至− 2.15；12项研究，n = 938），血清淀粉酶、肌酐和ALT同样改善。全因死亡率显著降低（RR = 0.55；95% CI：0.41至0.74；13项研究，n = 837），无显著异质性，且在各模式亚组间效应一致。TNF-α降低总体显著（SMD = − 1.38；95% CI：−2.37至− 0.38），但不同模式间无显著差异。SOFA评分及住院和ICU住院时间未显示一致性的显著改善。操作相关不良事件在各研究中报告不一致。所有汇总结局的证据确定性均评为极低（GRADE），反映了偏倚风险、不一致性和不精确性。SAP中的早期EBP与死亡率和关键炎症标志物的显著降低相关，同时疾病严重程度评分和生化参数也有所改善，但获益幅度因治疗模式而异。证据基础的地域集中性、各模式间的机制异质性、不良事件报告的不一致性以及极低的证据确定性，阻碍了常规推荐。在EBP能够纳入国际SAP指南之前，需要具有足够把握度的多中心随机对照试验，采用标准化方案、模式比较和安全性报告。
items.abstract_en: Severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) is the most critical form of acute pancreatitis (AP), characterized by a dysregulated systemic inflammatory response that drives early organ failure and mortality. Current management remains mainly supportive. Early blood purification (EBP) has been proposed as an adjunctive strategy to reduce circulating inflammatory mediators, yet prior syntheses have been limited by small trial sizes, heterogeneous modalities, and inconsistent reporting. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of early EBP in adults with SAP, with outcomes stratified by treatment modality and timing of initiation. A comprehensive search was conducted across six databases (PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Ovid, Embase, and the Cochrane Library) for studies published until June, 2026. Eligible studies enrolled adults with SAP and compared early EBP (continuous veno-venous hemofiltration [CVVH], high-volume hemofiltration [HVHF], combined continuous blood purification, hemoperfusion, plasma exchange, or hemadsorption) against standard medical management. Pooled effects were expressed as standardized mean differences (SMDs), mean differences (MDs), or risk ratios (RRs) using random-effects models, stratified a priori by treatment modality and, where feasible, by timing of initiation. Certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE framework. Twenty-one studies comprising 1,959 adults were included. Early EBP was associated with a significant overall reduction in IL-6 (SMD = − 1.55; 95% CI: −2.05 to − 1.05; 12 studies, n = 1,045) and CRP (SMD = − 1.14; 95% CI: −1.93 to − 0.34; 11 studies, n = 840), with effect sizes differing significantly across modalities for both markers. APACHE II score also improved significantly (MD = − 3.40; 95% CI: −4.64 to − 2.15; 12 studies, n = 938), as did serum amylase, creatinine, and ALT. All-cause mortality was significantly reduced (RR = 0.55; 95% CI: 0.41 to 0.74; 13 studies, n = 837), with no significant heterogeneity and consistent effects across modality subgroups. TNF-α reduction was significant overall (SMD = − 1.38; 95% CI: −2.37 to − 0.38) but did not differ significantly by modality. SOFA score, and hospital and ICU length of stay, showed no consistent significant improvement. Procedure-related adverse events were inconsistently reported across studies. Certainty of evidence was rated very low (GRADE) for all pooled outcomes, reflecting risk of bias, inconsistency, and imprecision. Early EBP in SAP is associated with significant reductions in mortality and key inflammatory markers, alongside improvements in disease severity scores and biochemical parameters, though the magnitude of benefit varies by treatment modality. The geographically concentrated evidence base, mechanistic heterogeneity across modalities, inconsistent adverse-event reporting, and very low certainty of evidence preclude routine recommendation. Adequately powered multicenter RCTs with standardized protocols, modality comparisons, and safety reporting are needed before EBP can be incorporated into international SAP guidelines.
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题表明其是一项系统综述与meta分析，评估早期血液净化对重症急性胰腺炎患者血清炎症介质的影响。由于未提供摘要，无法总结具体发现。

items.title_cn: 机器学习-随机生存森林预测模型预测首发急性胰腺炎短期复发
items.title_en: Machine learning–random survival forest prediction model for predicting short-term recurrence after first-episode acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn:
本研究旨在构建并评估一种机器学习——随机生存森林预测模型，用于预测首发急性胰腺炎（AP）后的短期复发。

回顾性分析2018年10月至2025年12月沧州市中心医院收治的568例AP患者，根据1年内是否复发分为复发性AP组（RAP）和非RAP组。在机器学习部分，患者按7：3比例随机分为训练队列（n = 398）和内部验证队列（n = 170）。来自另一家医院的77例患者作为外部验证队列用于模型评估。应用Cox回归分析筛选复发的预测因素，并构建随机生存森林模型。采用受试者工作特征曲线、校准曲线、决策曲线分析（DCA）和Shapley加法解释（SHAP）评估随机生存森林预测模型的性能。

约14.1%的首发AP病例（80/568）复发。Cox分析确定饮酒（HR = 2.35，95% CI = 1.37–4.05，P = 0.002）、甘油三酯（HR = 1.13，95% CI = 1.10–1.16，P < 0.001）和胰腺坏死（HR = 5.34，95% CI = 2.11–13.54，P < 0.001）为RAP的独立预测因素。列线图预测模型在训练队列中的曲线下面积为0.834（95% CI：0.765–0.891），在内部验证队列中为0.794（95% CI：0.677–0.903），在外部验证队列中为0.794（95% CI：0.657–0.909）。重要性排名前3位的变量依次为：甘油三酯、饮酒和胰腺坏死。随机生存森林预测模型在训练队列中的曲线下面积为0.947（95% CI：0.920–0.971），在内部验证队列中为0.832（95% CI：0.711–0.931），在外部验证队列中为0.815（95% CI：0.687–0.906）。校准曲线显示随机生存森林模型具有良好的预测能力，DCA证实该模型具有较强的临床实用性。SHAP分析确定甘油三酯为最关键的预测因子，饮酒和胰腺坏死为次要贡献因素。

随机生存森林模型是预测首发AP患者短期复发的有见地且有用的工具。

不适用。
items.abstract_en:
This study aimed to construct and assess a machine learning–random survival forest prediction model for predicting short-term recurrence after first-episode acute pancreatitis (AP).
 
 
 
 
 A total of 568 patients with AP admitted to Cangzhou Central Hospital from October 2018 to December 2025 were retrospectively analyzed and divided into the recurrent AP group (RAP) and non-RAP group according to whether recurrence occurred within 1 year. In the machine learning section, the patients were randomly divided into a training cohort (
 n
  = 398) and an internal validation cohort (
 n
  = 170) at a 7:3 ratio. An external validation cohort of 77 patients from another hospital was used for model evaluation. Cox regression analysis was applied to screen the predictive factors of recurrence, and a random survival forest model was constructed. The performance of the random survival forest prediction model was assessed using the receiver operating characteristic curve, calibration curve, decision curve analysis (DCA), and Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP).
 
 
 
 
 
 Approximately 14.1% of the first-episode AP cases (80/568) recurred. Cox analysis identified alcohol drinking (HR = 2.35, 95% CI = 1.37–4.05,
 P
  = 0.002), triglyceride (HR = 1.13, 95% CI = 1.10–1.16,
 P
  < 0.001), and pancreatic necrosis (HR = 5.34, 95% CI = 2.11–13.54,
 P
  < 0.001) as independent predictive factors of RAP. The nomogram prediction model achieved an area under the curve of 0.834 (95% CI: 0.765–0.891) in the training cohort, 0.794 (95% CI: 0.677–0.903) in the internal validation cohort, and 0.794 (95% CI: 0.657–0.909) in the external validation cohort. The top 3 variables in terms of importance were ranked as follows: triglyceride, alcohol drinking, and pancreatic necrosis. The random survival forest prediction model achieved an area under the curve of 0.947 (95% CI: 0.920–0.971) in the training cohort, 0.832 (95% CI: 0.711–0.931) in the internal validation cohort, and 0.815 (95% CI: 0.687–0.906) in the external validation cohort. The calibration curve showed that the random survival forest model had good predictive ability, and DCA confirmed that the model had strong clinical utility. SHAP analysis identified triglyceride as the most critical predictor, with secondary contributions from alcohol drinking and pancreatic necrosis.
 
 
 
 
 Random survival forest models are insightful and useful tools for predicting short-term recurrence for patients with first-episode AP.
 
 
 
 Not applicable.
items.journal: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
items.summary_cn: 该研究构建了随机生存森林模型预测首发急性胰腺炎1年内短期复发，发现饮酒、甘油三酯和胰腺坏死是独立预测因素，模型在训练、内部验证和外部验证队列中AUC分别为0.947、0.832和0.815，SHAP分析显示甘油三酯为最关键预测因子。

items.title_cn: 腹部急性外科疾病放射诊断的现代进展
items.title_en: MODERN ASPECTS OF RADIOLOGICAL DIAGNOSIS OF ACUTE SURGICAL DISEASES OF THE ABDOMEN
items.abstract_cn: 急性腹部外科疾病仍然是急诊入院的主要原因之一，需要快速、准确的诊断以降低发病率和死亡率。仅凭临床检查往往不足以区分急性阑尾炎、急性胆囊炎、肠梗阻、胃肠道穿孔、急性胰腺炎、肠系膜缺血和腹部创伤等疾病，这些疾病均可能表现为相互重叠的急性腹痛症状。本综述总结了当前影像学检查手段——X线平片、超声检查（包括床旁超声）、计算机断层扫描（CT）、CT血管造影和磁共振成像——在最常见急性外科疾病诊断流程中的作用。特别关注疾病特异性诊断标准（急性胆囊炎的东京指南、急性胰腺炎修订版亚特兰大分类）、超声与CT的准确性比较、全身CT和扩展的创伤超声重点评估（eFAST）在多发伤中的地位，以及在不影响诊断准确性的前提下减少辐射暴露的策略。本文提出了一种结构化、循证化的影像学检查流程，以指导日常外科实践中检查方式的选择。
items.abstract_en: Acute surgical diseases of the abdomen remain among the leading causes of emergency hospital admission and require rapid, accurate diagnosis to reduce morbidity and mortality. Clinical examination alone is often insufficient to differentiate between conditions such as acute appendicitis, acute cholecystitis, intestinal obstruction, gastrointestinal perforation, acute pancreatitis, mesenteric ischemia, and abdominal trauma, all of which may present with overlapping symptoms of acute abdominal pain. This review summarises the current role of imaging modalities — plain radiography, ultrasonography (including point-of-care ultrasound), computed tomography (CT), CT angiography, and magnetic resonance imaging — in the diagnostic algorithm of the most common acute surgical conditions. Particular attention is paid to disease-specific diagnostic criteria (Tokyo Guidelines for acute cholecystitis, the revised Atlanta classification of acute pancreatitis), the comparative accuracy of ultrasound versus CT, the place of whole-body CT and extended focused assessment with sonography for trauma (eFAST) in polytrauma, and strategies for reducing radiation exposure without compromising diagnostic accuracy. A structured, evidence-based imaging algorithm is proposed to guide the choice of modality in everyday surgical practice.
items.summary_cn: 该综述总结了平片、超声（含床旁超声）、CT、CT血管成像和MRI在急性阑尾炎、急性胆囊炎、肠梗阻、消化道穿孔、急性胰腺炎、肠系膜缺血及腹部创伤等常见急腹症诊断流程中的作用，并关注疾病特异性诊断标准（如急性胆囊炎的Tokyo指南、急性胰腺炎的修订版Atlanta分类）、超声与CT的准确性比较、全身CT与eFAST在多发伤中的地位，以及在不影响诊断准确性的前提下降低辐射暴露的策略，最终提出结构化、循证影像学算法以指导临床选择检查方式。

items.title_cn: 循环组织蛋白酶对胆囊炎、胆石症、原发性胆汁性胆管炎、原发性硬化性胆管炎、急性胰腺炎和慢性胰腺炎的因果效应：一项孟德尔随机化研究
items.title_en: Causal effects of circulating cathepsins on cholecystitis, cholelithiasis, primary biliary cholangitis, primary sclerosing cholangitis, acute pancreatitis, and chronic pancreatitis: A Mendelian randomization study.
items.abstract_cn: 胆囊、胆道和胰腺疾病是以炎症、上皮损伤和纤维化为特征的非肿瘤性疾病。组织蛋白酶是溶酶体蛋白酶，参与炎症激活、免疫调节、细胞外基质周转和胰酶激活。组织蛋白酶失调与肝胰胆管病理之间的观察性关联可能反映混杂因素或反向因果关系。本研究采用孟德尔随机化（MR）评估循环组织蛋白酶是否对胆囊、胆道和胰腺疾病具有因果影响。我们使用来自INTERVAL全基因组关联研究（3301名欧洲参与者）中与循环组织蛋白酶水平相关的遗传变异进行了双样本MR分析。胆囊炎、胆石症、原发性胆汁性胆管炎（PBC）、原发性硬化性胆管炎、急性胰腺炎和慢性胰腺炎的汇总统计数据提取自欧洲血统全基因组关联研究联盟。工具变量在P < 5 × 10⁻⁶、连锁不平衡r² < 0.001的条件下选取，以在保持独立性的同时最大化工具可用性。逆方差加权估计器为主要模型，辅以加权中位数、MR-Egger和基于模式的方法。通过F统计量、MR-Egger截距、MR多效性残差和离群值以及Cochran Q评估工具强度、多效性和异质性。Benjamini-Hochberg错误发现率（FDR）校正用于多重检验，敏感性分析包括留一法检验和PhenoScanner过滤。经FDR校正后，两个组织蛋白酶B关联仍具有显著性。遗传预测的较高组织蛋白酶B与较低的PBC风险相关（比值比[OR] = 0.784；95%置信区间[CI]：0.664-0.925；P = .004；FDR = 0.022），并与较高的胆囊炎风险相关（OR = 1.080；95% CI：1.022-1.141；P = .006；FDR = 0.018）。其他名义关联未通过校正，应谨慎解读：组织蛋白酶O与胆石症（OR = 1.001；95% CI：1.000-1.003；P = .033；FDR = 0.199）、组织蛋白酶L2与急性胰腺炎（OR = 1.156；95% CI：1.008-1.327；P = .038；FDR = 0.227）、组织蛋白酶H与慢性胰腺炎（OR = 0.922；95% CI：0.853-0.997；P = .043；FDR = 0.255）。未检测到异质性、水平多效性或反向因果关系。遗传预测的组织蛋白酶B似乎对PBC具有保护作用，但增加胆囊炎风险，支持循环组织蛋白酶在肝胰胆管疾病中具有不同的因果作用。涉及组织蛋白酶O、L2和H的关联为名义性，需要谨慎解读、重复验证和进一步的功能研究。
items.abstract_en: Gallbladder, biliary, and pancreatic disorders are nonneoplastic diseases marked by inflammation, epithelial injury, and fibrosis. Cathepsins are lysosomal proteases involved in inflammatory activation, immune regulation, extracellular matrix turnover, and pancreatic enzyme activation. Observational links between dysregulated cathepsins and hepatopancreatobiliary pathology could reflect confounding or reverse causation. This study used Mendelian randomization (MR) to assess whether circulating cathepsins causally influence gallbladder, biliary, and pancreatic diseases. We conducted a 2-sample MR analysis using genetic variants associated with circulating cathepsin levels from the INTERVAL genome-wide association studies (3301 European participants). Summary statistics for cholecystitis, cholelithiasis, primary biliary cholangitis (PBC), primary sclerosing cholangitis, acute pancreatitis, and chronic pancreatitis were extracted from European-ancestry genome-wide association studies consortia. Instrumental variables were selected at P < 5 × 10-6 with linkage disequilibrium r2 < 0.001 to maximize instrument availability while retaining independence. The inverse-variance weighted estimator was the primary model, complemented by weighted median, MR-Egger, and mode-based methods. Instrument strength, pleiotropy, and heterogeneity were evaluated via F statistics, MR-Egger intercept, MR Pleiotropy RESidual Sum and Outlier, and Cochran Q. Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) correction accounted for multiple testing, and sensitivity analyses included leave-one-out tests and PhenoScanner filtering. Two cathepsin B associations remained significant after FDR correction. Higher genetically predicted cathepsin B was linked to lower PBC risk (odds ratio [OR] = 0.784; 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.664-0.925; P = .004; FDR = 0.022) and higher cholecystitis risk (OR = 1.080; 95% CI: 1.022-1.141; P = .006; FDR = 0.018). Other nominal associations did not survive correction and should be interpreted cautiously: cathepsin O with cholelithiasis (OR = 1.001; 95% CI: 1.000-1.003; P = .033; FDR = 0.199), cathepsin L2 with acute pancreatitis (OR = 1.156; 95% CI: 1.008-1.327; P = .038; FDR = 0.227), and cathepsin H with chronic pancreatitis (OR = 0.922; 95% CI: 0.853-0.997; P = .043; FDR = 0.255). No heterogeneity, horizontal pleiotropy, or reverse causation was detected. Genetically predicted cathepsin B appears protective for PBC but increases cholecystitis risk, supporting distinct causal roles among circulating cathepsins in hepatopancreatobiliary diseases. Associations involving cathepsin O, L2, and H were nominal, warranting cautious interpretation, replication, and further functional studies.
items.summary_cn: 该研究通过孟德尔随机化方法发现，遗传预测的组织蛋白酶B水平升高与原发性胆汁性胆管炎风险降低相关（OR=0.784），但与胆囊炎风险升高相关（OR=1.080），且这些关联经FDR校正后仍显著；组织蛋白酶O、L2、H与胆石症、急性胰腺炎、慢性胰腺炎的关联仅为名义显著，未通过多重检验校正。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
